info.title: Relay Duo 1 Coordination API
info.description: Relay Duo 1 contract for deterministic clearing, CREAO coordination, Hyphenate finance, financial controls, and the Duo 2 execution/settlement boundary. Money is integer minor units and timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC. Solver and finance results are persisted; no LLM computes feasibility, allocations, compensation, or ledger entries.

servers.description: Replace with the public HTTPS relay host

bearerAuth.description: RELAY_API_KEY or a scoped API key. Agent keys cannot record participant approvals.

ContractHeader.name: X-Relay-Contract
ContractHeader.description: Required on every request except /v1/health. Unknown versions are rejected with 400 unsupported_contract.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every write. Identical requests replay the original response for 24 hours. Reuse with a different body, method, or path returns 409 idempotency_conflict.

Money.description: Integer minor units. Never a floating-point amount.

executable.description: True only for a worker offer with a live provider authorization and a future expiry. Public listings are context, never executable inventory.

Proposal.description: Deterministic engine output. P0 seeds a fixture labelled engine.name=seed-fixture and engine.solver_status=fixture_not_solver. P1 must replace it with a persisted solver proposal.

BadRequest.description: Missing or unsupported contract header, missing idempotency key, or invalid request.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked bearer credential.

Forbidden.description: The credential is valid but lacks the required human/participant authority.

NotFound.description: Workload, party, deal, or approval request not found.

Conflict.description: Stale terms version, expired request, duplicate decision, reservation conflict, or idempotency conflict.

NotImplemented.description: P0 solver/counteroffer skeleton. The request was not applied.

post.summary: Ask the deterministic engine to search for a clearing proposal
post.description: Runs the deterministic clearing engine over persisted executable offers, provider authorizations, active allocations, workload constraints, and the optional mandate. Supports direct rental, one-for-one exchange, bounded conditional chains, and closed cycles. A feasible proposal is persisted with versioned deal terms and participant approval requests. The response includes proposal (persisted), recommended, proposals, rejected, and infeasible_options. If no option clears the mandate, the response is 200 with status no_feasible_deal and no deal.

200.description: A feasible proposal was persisted (status feasible) or no option cleared the mandate (status no_feasible_deal).

201.description: A feasible proposal and deal were persisted.

post.summary: Ask the engine to re-solve against a buyer price ceiling
post.description: Reprices a provider commitment. A human provider may counter for its own party; an agent must present an active participant-issued mandate. A new deal version is persisted, prior pending approvals are superseded, and new approvals are created. Stale versions and mandate breaches are rejected before any version change.

201.description: New deal version with reset approvals and negotiation event.

Run the Elastic Financial Investigator for a financial exception
post.description: CREAO invokes the deployed Elastic Agent Builder agent. The agent searches indexed, read-only records; the backend rejects citations that do not match actual indexed documents. The agent cannot change accounting state; a successful run only moves an open exception to investigating. Correction, approval, and payment remain in the deterministic workflow.

200.description: Investigation completed, completed with rejected citations, or returned insufficient evidence. The financial exception is not approved or resolved by this call.

502.description: The agent returned no valid structured findings.

503.description: Elastic or Agent Builder is unavailable or not configured.
